samples.question: Colored squares are ON and pale squares are OFF. The orange-framed center is the tracked cell, and the six orange beads mean six rounds. In every round, update all squares simultaneously: a square is ON next exactly when one of its four edge-sharing neighbors was ON; otherwise it is OFF. Beyond the board counts as OFF. After six rounds, is the tracked center ON or OFF?
